name: EX6-PHASE-0
note: Which phase carries the named-80 deletion crest? Delta_mode = sum over eval seeds 7001/8002/9003 of (gate_mode - gate_NONE), the NONE (unmasked) arm run fresh in-load as the paired baseline. Phase law = the traj capture's (GT1-TRAJ-CORR): T>1 router call = prefill (resets tail flag), first T==1 call = prompt_tail, later T==1 calls = decode; PROMPT masks prefill+prompt_tail, DECODE masks decode only. Signs 3/3 = per-seed deltas same-sign via each bar's signs conjunct (conjunct-local metric triples, first live use). Refutation uses applies_only_if_bars_fire (first live use): the decode-carry hypothesis is judged only when the wrapper qualification holds AND the ALL crest reproduces. INTERPRETATION FENCE: a fired bar 6 separation reads 'decode-phase masking carries more of the effect than prompt-phase masking at this mask and dose', not 'decode selections cause failure' — recruitment causality stays open; anatomy reads (failure enrichment) remain correlates.

none.description: MODE=NONE — router untouched, paired-full baseline, fresh per seed in-load

all.description: MODE=ALL — named-80 mask in every phase (static-deletion reproduction)

prompt.description: MODE=PROMPT — mask during prefill + prompt_tail only

decode.description: MODE=DECODE — mask during generated-token decode steps only

bars.name: QUALIFICATION
bars.description: the NEW wrapper at seed 1001: MODE=NONE reproduces the booked full128 cell (59, {1:22,2:19,3:18}) and MODE=ALL reproduces the booked ex3_del_invp cell (78, {1:28,2:26,3:24}), cell-exact. Any mismatch = INSTRUMENT-INVALID, treatment does not fire.

bars.name: ALL-CREST
bars.description: the crest reproduces through the phase wrapper on the fresh triple: Delta_all >= +21, signs 3/3.

bars.name: DECODE-SUFFICIENCY
bars.description: decode-only masking alone clears the crest bar: Delta_decode >= +21, signs 3/3.

bars.name: DECODE-RECAPTURE
bars.description: non-suppressing range: |Delta_all - Delta_decode| <= 10 — decode masking recaptures the full effect within the house pair floor.

bars.name: PROMPT-SUFFICIENCY
bars.description: prompt-phase masking alone clears the crest bar: Delta_prompt >= +21, signs 3/3.

bars.name: PHASE-SEPARATION
bars.description: Delta_decode - Delta_prompt >= +21: the decode phase carries measurably more of the effect.

bars.name: INTERACTION
bars.description: diagnostic: |Delta_all - (Delta_prompt + Delta_decode)| >= 21 flags non-additive phase interaction. An excursion is a result, never an alarm.

refuted_if: The decode-carry hypothesis (from the EX5 anatomy: decode-time failure enrichment is the harm correlate) is REFUTED if, with the wrapper qualified (bar 1) and the crest reproducing (bar 2), decode-only masking yields nothing: Delta_decode <= 0 pooled. Judged only under bars 1 and 2 (precedence + condition).
registered_prior: House, on the record, MEDIUM confidence (two anatomy reads pull opposite ways: selection mass is prefill-heavy, failure enrichment is decode-side; the prior follows the enrichment): bar 1 exact; bar 2 fires around the +43/+55 class; bar 3 FIRES (decode carries most); bar 4 holds; bar 5 does NOT fire (prompt-phase contribution small); bar 6 fires; bar 7 quiet (roughly additive). The named live alternative, on the record: the prefill-mass story — bar 5 fires and bar 3 does not — would invert the mechanism reading toward context-assembly harm rather than generation-time harm.
